usages.explain: It means "because I really want to" or "because I really don't want to." What follows are contents indicating "therefore, not minding the trouble, even doing things I don’t want to do."

examples.content: 好きな歌手のコンサートを見に行きたいばかりに、病気に託けて休みを取った。
examples.transcription: すきなかしゅのこんさーとをみにいきたいばかりに、びょうきにかこつけてやすみをとった。
examples.mean: <p class="MsoNormal">I just wanted to go see my favorite singer's concert, but I decided to take a day off due to illness. </p>

examples.content: 仕事を早く終わらせたいばかりに、昼休みも取らずに頑張った。
examples.transcription: しごとをはやくおわらせたいばかりに、ひるやすみもとらずにがんばった。
examples.mean: I worked hard without even taking a lunch break because I wanted to finish my work as quickly as possible.

usages.synopsis: V ます + たいばかりに

title: ... たいばかりに => because I want to…
